sets.title: Earnings Quality 案例
sets.vignette:
NovaDx is a contract research and manufacturing services company. In the most recent fiscal year, NovaDx reported revenue growth of 28%, well above the industry average of 9%. Selected financial data (in millions):

                          Prior Year    Current Year
Revenue                     1,150         1,472
Net income                    186           320
Cash flow from operations     201           176
Accounts receivable           196           388
Inventories                   142           151
Capitalized software costs     12            68

Management attributes the growth to a new distribution strategy: products are shipped to distributors on extended payment terms with a broad right of return, while revenue is recognized at shipment (gross). In the earnings release, management highlights "adjusted EBITDA," which excludes share-based compensation of 41 million. The audit committee raised no objections.

sets.title: ESG Integration 案例
sets.vignette: Analyst Li Wei is valuing Meridian Chemical, a bulk-chemical producer. Her base-case DCF uses long-term growth of 2.0% and WACC of 8.0%. A new carbon pricing regime, effective 2030, is expected to reduce Meridian's annual operating cash flows by roughly 4%. Approximately 30% of production capacity is located in coastal flood-prone zones. Meridian has published a decarbonization roadmap with capex commitments, and 40% of executive bonuses are tied to emissions targets. The company also issued a 5-year green bond at a yield 25 bp below its conventional bond of similar maturity, ring-fencing proceeds for emissions-reduction projects with annual reporting to investors. Li Wei notes that two sovereign wealth funds on the shareholder register have engaged management on board independence this year.

questions.kp: Revenue Red Flags 收入红旗
questions.stem: Which feature of NovaDx's results most directly challenges the quality of its reported revenue?
opts: Revenue growth of 28% versus an industry average of 9%
Accounts receivable growing much faster than revenue, combined with extended payment terms and a broad right of return
The use of adjusted EBITDA excluding share-based compensation
Inventories growing broadly in line with revenue
questions.exp: 应收增速（196→388，+98%）远超收入增速（+28%）+ 放宽信用政策 + 大额退货权，是收入质量恶化的直接信号，典型的压货/提前确认模式。A 只说增长快，不直接证明质量问题；C 是盈利质量问题，不是收入质量问题；D 存货正常反而是好消息。

questions.kp: Accruals Ratio 应计比率计算
questions.stem: NovaDx's average net operating assets (NOA) for the year were 700 million, and its cash flow from investing was –90 million (primarily capital expenditures and the capitalized software). Using the cash-flow-based approach, the accruals ratio is closest to:
questions.exp: 现金流法 Accruals Ratio = (NI − CFO − CFI) ÷ Average NOA = (320 − 176 − (−90)) ÷ 700 = 234 ÷ 700 = 33.4%。公式是'减 CFI'，CFI 为负值所以相当于把投资流出加回来——应计包含经营性应计（NI−CFO）和投资性应计（−CFI 中的资本化等部分）。比率越高，利润中未变现部分越多，盈利质量越低。

questions.kp: Earnings Normalization 盈利正常化调整
questions.stem: Which of the following adjustments would an analyst most appropriately make when assessing NovaDx's underlying earnings quality? (Select all that apply)
opts: Reverse the capitalized software costs by treating the current-year capitalization as an expense
Exclude share-based compensation from expenses because it is a non-cash charge
Treat the receivables buildup as a reduction in revenue quality rather than sustainable growth
Accept management's adjusted EBITDA as the best measure of recurring earnings
questions.exp: A 对：资本化软件成本从 12→68 百万异常跳升，费用化还原才能看到真实利润。B 错：SBC 是真实经济成本（稀释股东），CFA 明确不应加回。C 对：应收堆积=收入含金量下降，应下调可持续性判断。D 错：管理层自定义指标需要分析师自行正常化，不可直接采信。

questions.kp: Reporting vs Earnings Quality 报告质量vs盈利质量
questions.stem: The audit committee raising no objections is best characterized as:
opts: Sufficient evidence of high reporting quality
Relevant but insufficient evidence; governance mechanisms and auditor incentives must also be assessed
Evidence that earnings quality is high
Irrelevant to the assessment of financial reporting quality
questions.exp: 治理机制（审计委员会、审计师独立性、股权激励压力）是评估报告质量的证据链之一，但单独一项不构成充分证据。C 张冠李戴：治理属于报告质量维度，与盈利质量无关。A' sufficient'是陷阱词，案例题见到 sufficient/always/never 要警惕。

questions.stem: In Li Wei's valuation of Meridian, the carbon pricing regime and coastal facility exposure are most appropriately classified as:
opts: Immaterial, because the carbon costs begin in 2030 and are not reflected in current financials
Material ESG factors, because they are expected to affect future cash flows and/or the discount rate
Governance factors rather than environmental factors
Relevant only for investors pursuing impact investing
questions.exp: 重大性的判据是'是否影响现金流或折现率'，与时间远近无关。碳定价直接削减现金流，洪水风险影响 WACC 与资产减值——都是 ESG 整合必须处理的重大因素。A 是典型错误选项；C 归类错误；D 混淆了 ESG 整合与影响力投资。

questions.kp: ESG Integration Methods 整合方法
questions.stem: Li Wei builds two valuation scenarios — moderate and aggressive carbon pricing — and reports a valuation range instead of a point estimate. This approach is best described as:
opts: Adjusting the discount rate for ESG risk
Scenario analysis, adjusting expected cash flows under alternative ESG outcomes
Negative screening applied to valuation
Greenwashing mitigation
questions.exp: 情景分析：对碳价设不同路径→各情景下现金流不同→估值取区间。A 动的是分母，本题动的是分子（不同情景的现金流）。C 负面清单是组合构建层面的筛选，与估值方法无关。

questions.stem: The 25 bp lower yield on Meridian's green bond relative to its conventional bond is best interpreted as:
opts: Evidence that green bonds always trade at lower yields than conventional bonds
A greenium, reflecting investor demand for the labeled green use of proceeds and reporting commitments
A signal that the green bond carries higher credit risk
A violation of ICMA Green Bond Principles
questions.exp: Greenium：绿债因投资者需求强而收益率更低。'always'（A）是陷阱词——绿溢价的存在与否取决于市场，并非定律。C 方向反了：收益率更低意味着风险定价更低不是更高。D 相反：公司按 ICMA 四要素（用途、评估流程、资金管理、报告）操作正是合规表现。

questions.kp: Responsible Investing Approaches 责任投资方式
questions.stem: Which of the following describe approaches demonstrated in the vignette? (Select all that apply)
opts: Engagement/stewardship, as practiced by the sovereign wealth funds
Thematic investing, via the green bond's emissions-reduction focus
Negative screening, because Meridian operates in chemicals
Impact investing, because the green bond finances emissions reductions
questions.exp: A 对：主权基金通过沟通推动董事会独立=积极所有权/尽责管理。B 错：绿债是公司融资行为，不是投资者的主题投资。C 错：负向筛选是投资者剔除行业的行为，文中没有任何投资者因此剔除 Meridian。D 错：绿债是普通债务投资，投资者首要目标仍是财务回报，不构成影响力投资（影响力投资要求可度量的社会/环境效益为首要目标）。

questions.stem: A bank reports interest income of 62 million, interest expense of 28 million, and average interest-earning assets of 1,200 million. Its net interest margin is closest to:
questions.exp: NIM = (62 − 28) ÷ 1,200 = 34/1,200 = 2.83%。净息差用平均生息资产作分母，不要错用总资产或总负债。

questions.stem: A property insurer reports a loss ratio of 71% and an expense ratio of 33%. The combined ratio and the most likely conclusion are:
opts: 104%; underwriting operations are unprofitable and the company relies on investment income
104%; the company is profitable on an underwriting basis
38%; underwriting is highly profitable
97.7%; underwriting margin is thin but positive
questions.exp: Combined Ratio = 71% + 33% = 104% > 100% → 承保亏损 4%，盈利只能靠投资收益支撑（财险公司常见模式，也解释了其利润波动性）。D 的 97.7% 是把 71/（71+33) 之类的错误算法。

questions.kp: Free Cash Flow Hypothesis 自由现金流假说
questions.stem: According to the free cash flow hypothesis (Jensen), a mature firm with large stable free cash flows and few growth opportunities should most likely:
opts: Retain all cash to maximize managerial discretion
Increase payouts, because committing to payouts reduces the free cash flow available for managerial overinvestment
Issue new debt and hold the proceeds as cash
Cut dividends to signal financial strength
questions.exp: Jensen 的自由现金流假说：管理层手中现金越多越容易乱投资（帝国建造），提高分红/回购把现金交还股东，压缩代理成本。这是'分红有益论'中基于代理成本的论证，与信号理论（C/D 的分红逻辑）区分记忆。

questions.stem: A company announces it will repurchase up to 2 million shares, inviting shareholders to tender shares within the range of 48 to 54 per share, and will determine the lowest price within that range that allows it to buy the desired quantity. This method is a:
opts: Fixed-price tender offer
Dutch auction tender offer
Open market repurchase
Direct negotiation repurchase
questions.exp: 荷兰式拍卖回购：给出价格区间，股东投标，按能买到目标数量的最低价格统一成交。固定价要约没有区间；公开市场回购是直接在二级市场买，无投标过程。
